headline: Northern Trust Re-Appointed by The General Pension and Social Security Authority
summary: ABU DHABI, United Arab Emirates, August 05, 2026--The General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA) has renewed its mandate with Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS), extending a long-standing relationship which began in 2012.
